meta.derivedFrom: auxBulles new (v3, synced 2026-10-05): the azure ramp, inks, surfaces, materials, type scale, 4px grid, radii, elevation and motion are carried over unchanged. Muster adds what an operations dashboard needs and an encyclopaedia did not: status signals, a console well for logs, chart series, data type styles and dense app-shell layout tokens.
meta.status: v1 — light theme only, as in the parent system; the console well is the one dark surface.

tokens.name: azure-50
tokens.usage: Faintest brand tint: hovered table row, hovered nav row. `ink` 14.8:1.

tokens.name: azure-100
tokens.usage: Selected nav row, chip ground, selected segment. Carries `ink` only — 13.0:1.

tokens.name: azure-200
tokens.usage: Pressed soft button, hover hairline of an outline chip, small labels on `brand-deep`.

tokens.name: azure-500
tokens.usage: Bright brand blue: the focus ring, display italics from 24px up. `ink-on-fill` 4.7:1.

tokens.name: azure-600
tokens.usage: Working brand blue: links, primary button ground, the active nav marker, chart series 1. 6.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: azure-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of anything on `azure-600`.

tokens.name: azure-800
tokens.usage: Structural fills under white at any size: the top bar. 11.5:1 with `ink-on-fill`.

tokens.name: azure-900
tokens.usage: Deepest step: the pressed primary button.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The ground behind the app shell's content area. Every ink and status ink clears 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, the sidebar. The default ground for every ink.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: a table header row, a disabled field, the track of a meter, inline code.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: The one tinted panel: an info banner, the YAML preview's header.

tokens.name: material-sheet
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and modals with `backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(8px)`. Falls back to `surface`.

tokens.name: material-window
tokens.usage: Controls cut through the top bar: the search field and the environment pill. White on it 4.7:1 or better.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, table cells on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy that must be read: descriptions, process commands. 6.9:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, PIDs, counts, column headers. 5.6:1 on `surface`, 5.0:1 on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a saturated fill — the bar, a primary or danger button, a status fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, primary button ground, active nav marker, selection.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of anything painted `brand`.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Display italics at 24px and up.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The top bar band. Always with `ink-on-fill`.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: The one warm dot in the Muster mark, on `brand-deep`. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and the wash behind a brand panel.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and grouped-list rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a panel sitting on `surface`, an input at rest. Decorative.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that mean something: a checkbox, a selected card, a chart axis. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, never removed.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Running / healthy: status dot, label and the ok count. 5.9:1 on `surface`, 5.3:1 on `status-ok-soft`. Never the only signal — pair with the word.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Running badge. Carries `status-ok` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Starting, restarting, degraded, a limit near. 5.6:1 on `surface`, 5.0:1 on `status-warn-soft`.

tokens.name: status-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Starting / Degraded badge and a warning banner.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Crashed, failed health check, a blocked launch; the danger button ground (with `ink-on-fill`, 6.6:1). 6.6:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Crashed badge and an error banner. Carries `status-error` 5.6:1.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Stopped / not launched. Grey is a state here, not a disabled control: it stays readable.

tokens.name: status-idle-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Stopped badge.

tokens.name: console-ground
tokens.usage: The log console well — the one dark surface in the system, derived from `azure-900`. Always at `radius-md` inside a light panel.

tokens.name: console-ink
tokens.usage: Log lines on `console-ground`. 14.0:1.

tokens.name: console-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps and process prefixes in the console. 7.2:1.

tokens.name: console-info
tokens.usage: INFO level tag in the console. 8.6:1.

tokens.name: console-ok
tokens.usage: Ready / health-ok lines in the console. 9.9:1.

tokens.name: console-warn
tokens.usage: WARN level tag in the console. 10.1:1.

tokens.name: console-error
tokens.usage: ERROR level tag in the console. 8.2:1.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series: CPU.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series: memory. auxBulles' coral, darkened; differs from `chart-1` in lightness as well as hue. A mark colour (4.49:1 on `surface`): never set text in it.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

families.display: Newsreader, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
families.sans: Archivo, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The app name in an app's title triad.

styles.name: triad-standfirst
styles.usage: Line 3 of the triad in `brand-bright`: the app's id or launch command.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Page title of a list screen (Fleet, Settings).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in `ink-faint`.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells and dense rows. New in Muster: an ops table at 15px wraps too soon.

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, column headers (sentence case), in `ink-faint`.

styles.name: ui-micro
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar. The floor.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The figure on a metric card, with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, PIDs, ports, paths, config keys; on `surface-sunken` when inline.

styles.name: console
styles.usage: Log lines in the console well, in `console-ink`.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small buttons; between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, nav row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default gap; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content side padding and the gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: New in Muster: inline code, a PID chip, a meter track. Small enough to sit inside a 14px table row.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav rows, small cards, inputs inside dense forms.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, the console well, menus, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: border-hairline

tokens.name: border-rule

tokens.name: elevation-2

tokens.name: row-height
